children: Real behavior change, led by specialists
Private training and board-and-train for the dogs other programs give up on — reactivity, aggression, puppy foundations and service-dog work. It starts with an assessment.

children: Every trainer here works cases full-time — reactivity, aggression, anxiety and obedience. You get the specialist your dog’s behavior actually calls for.
We assess first, then follow a clear, repeatable plan built on how dogs actually learn. You’ll know the why behind every step and how to measure progress.
Train where the behavior happens — in your home and your routine — or send your dog for immersive board-and-train and get the skills handed back to you.
The relationship doesn’t end at the last session. Graduates keep access to follow-ups and guidance, so the results stick for the life of the dog.

children: The K9 Method: assess, plan, transform

Most training fails because it treats symptoms and skips the cause. We do the opposite — a real assessment to understand why your dog does what it does, then a step-by-step plan that changes the behavior at its root.
And we train you as much as the dog. When you understand the method and can run it yourself, the calm, confident dog you met in session is the one you keep at home.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Book by name — you’ll work with the specialist whose expertise fits your dog.
Fifteen years on complex behavior cases and service-dog foundations. Dana builds the plan the whole team trains to.
Calm under pressure with the toughest cases — leash reactivity, resource guarding and bite histories handled safely and humanely.
Runs the board-and-train program and rock-solid obedience work, then transfers every skill back to the owner.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who K9 Method is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A focused working dog holding a steady sit, eyes locked on its handler

children: K9 Method exists for the dogs that group classes and quick fixes couldn’t reach — the reactive, the anxious, the ones with a bite history and an owner running out of options. We take those cases seriously, and we get results.
Our promise is simple: an honest assessment, a plan grounded in how dogs actually learn, and a specialist who treats your dog’s behavior — and your family’s safety — like it matters. Because it does.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: We never sell a program before we understand the dog. Every relationship starts with a real evaluation and a written plan you own.
Clear, consistent, science-based training — no intimidation, no gimmicks. We change behavior by teaching, not by force.
We coach the owner as hard as the dog and back it with lifetime follow-up support, so the transformation holds for good.
